description: Worldwide ceremony civil-RECOGNITION mapping entry — one record per (covenant rite × jurisdiction), recording INFORMATIONALLY whether and how a religious / covenant rite (marriage / naming / funeral) carries any civil-law recognition, and the SEPARATE civil-registration step a member must perform themselves (ADR-2605263400). CONSTITUTIONAL BOUNDARY: musubi performs covenant ceremonies (Reformed 万人祭司, NO clergy class — G3) and does NOT confer civil status, does NOT register marriages/births/deaths, and is NOT an official channel. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — wayfinding scaffold, NOT legal advice (UPL boundary), NEVER live reliance. `verificationStatus` gates any surfacing (G14): `unverified-seed` => no live reliance, MUST be human/Council-verified within the freshness window first. Never fabricate 手続き / 様式 / 根拠法令 (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` mandatory; authority / channel / legalBasis are best-effort public references EXPECTED to drift (per-jurisdiction / per-municipality variation).

recognitionId.description: Stable slug mirroring the seed entry id (e.g. 'jp-marriage-notification-konin-todoke')

title.description: Human-readable label of the civil step / status

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (ISO-3 e.g. jpn / usa / deu / fra / gbr / can / aus / sgp / ind, or 'eu-wide' for EU-wide instruments)

ceremonyType.description: Covenant-rite dimension this civil step maps to

authority.description: Civil authority that performs / issues the step (NOT musubi — musubi is never the authority)

channel.description: Where the member self-performs the SEPARATE civil step (office / portal). Best-effort public reference; EXPECTED to drift. NOT an official channel of musubi.

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 / statutory basis — MANDATORY (G8). Never fabricated.

language.description: Primary language of the authority's published guidance (e.g. ja / en / de / fr)

provenance.description: Source URL (authority's published statute / guidance) — MANDATORY (G8)

confidence.description: Maintainer confidence in the mapping accuracy at lastVerified

lastVerified.description: When the entry was last checked; freshness measured against freshnessWindowDays

verificationStatus.description: G14 reliance gate. unverified-seed => NO live reliance; entry MUST be human/Council-verified (and within freshness window) before any guidance is surfaced.

notes.description: Boundary + drift narrative. Reiterates: musubi performs covenant ceremonies (Reformed 万人祭司, NO clergy class), does NOT confer civil status; INFORMATIONAL only, no legal advice (UPL boundary).
